cases.case_label: 330-bp retrotransposed non-coding sequence in DMD exon 67
cases.mechanism_detail: De novo 330-bp retrotransposition-mediated insertion of part of a novel non-coding transcript (chr11 origin) into DMD exon 67 induced exon 67 skipping, creating a premature stop codon. Insert carried antisense polyadenylation signal with poly(T) and a TSD; later shown (PMID 22095564) to be an L1 orphan 3' transduction.
cases.quote: The insertion induced exon 67-skipping in the dystrophin mRNA, creating a premature stop codon.
